key_facts: REVIEWED Sat Sep 12 (T+1d to Sun Sep 13 Okinawa gubernatorial election; Exa Ryukyu Shimpo x2 + Sankei + Okinawa Times + Jiji Sep 12; UNCHANGED at Genta Koja 0.66, Denny Tamaki 0.33, sum=0.99): Final day of campaigning and early voting wrapped smoothly with no new polls or late shock. Okinawa Election Commission reported final 16-day early voting (Aug 28-Sep 12) at 347,169 ballots (29.51% of 1,176,321 electorate); through day 15 (Sep 11), cumulative early ballots were 273,584 (23.26%), virtually identical to 2022's 273,397 (+187 votes / +0.01pp), normalizing after the earlier municipal-overlap spike. At final Naha rallies on Sat Sep 12, challenger Genta Koja (42, backed by unified 6-party LDP/Ishin/DPP/Sanseito/Conservative/Komeito-Okinawa coalition) appeared alongside LDP's Yasutoshi Nishimura, Ishin leader Hirofumi Yoshimura, and DPP SG Kazuya Shimba stressing broad central/opposition ties and economic revitalization, while 2-term incumbent Denny Tamaki (66) emphasized his 8-year record and criticized SNS misinformation/defamation while notably omitting the US military base / Henoko issue from his final Naha speech. Polls open Sun Sep 13 07:00-20:00 JST, with outcome expected ~23:00 JST. Holding 0.66/0.33 anchored on Sep 5-6 Yomiuri/Asahi-Okinawa Times/Kyodo polls and unified 6-party coalition.
